measure-word-reduplication.title_tr: Measure Word Reduplication (个个, 天天: "every")
measure-word-reduplication.intro_tr: Certain measure words (个, 天, 年, 家, 人 and the like) create a special pattern that carries the meaning of "every" when repeated consecutively twice: 个个 ("each one"), 天天 ("every day"), 人人 ("everyone") and so on. This structure is a more emphatic, more emotional, and generally colloquial version of the 每 + measure word pattern. Almost always, 都 [dōu] immediately follows the reduplicated measure word and emphasizes the meaning of "all/every one without exception." Only certain commonly used single-syllable measure words can be reduplicated in this way; not every measure word fits this pattern. This pattern can be used both as the subject of a sentence (个个都很好) and as a temporal adverbial (天天学习).

tables.caption_tr: Basic Structure: Measure Word Reduplication

jishi-ye.intro_tr: The 即使...也... [jíshǐ...yě...] structure means '...even if...', '...even though...' in Turkish and consists of two parts: with 即使 a hypothetical situation (not necessarily realized, even exaggerated/extreme) is indicated, while in the part starting with 也, the consequence that would not change even if this situation were to occur is explained. The most important feature of this pattern is that whether the situation expressed with 即使 is real or not is unimportant — a person can use it as a hypothesis or even an impossible scenario. For this reason, the 即使...也... pattern differs from the 虽然...但是... pattern (meaning '...although...but...') which expresses a real/experienced situation. 即使 can be at the beginning of the sentence or immediately after the subject, but 也 always comes after the subject of the second sentence and BEFORE the verb. It is a conjunction frequently encountered at HSK4 level and commonly used in everyday conversation.

tables.caption_tr: Basic Structure Formula
rows: A: varsayımsal/uç durum; B: A gerçekleşse bile değişmeyen sonuç
即使下雨，我们也要去。 [jíshǐ xiàyǔ, wǒmen yě yào qù]
Özne + 即使 + A, Özne + 也 + B
Aynı özne ise 即使 öznenin önünde ya da arkasında olabilir
他即使生病，也坚持工作。 [tā jíshǐ shēngbìng, yě jiānchí gōngzuò]
即使 + A(özne1), Özne2 + 也 + B
Farklı özneler kullanılabilir; 即使 cümlenin en başında kalır
即使他不来，我们也要开始。 [jíshǐ tā bù lái, wǒmen yě yào kāishǐ]
也 HER ZAMAN ikinci cümlenin öznesinden sonra, fiilden önce gelir; asla cümle başında olmaz
我也要去 (doğru) / 也我要去 (yanlış)
footnotes_tr: 即使 can appear at the beginning of the sentence as well as immediately after the subject; these two usages are the same in meaning.

tables.caption_tr: Comparison of 即使...也... with Similar Conjunctions
rows: Varsayımsal — gerçek olmayabilir, hatta uç bir örnek olabilir
即使天塌下来，他也不慌。 [jíshǐ tiān tā xiàlái, tā yě bù huāng]
虽然下雨了，但是我们还是去了。 [suīrán xiàyǔ le, dànshì wǒmen háishi qù le]
Gerçek — 虽然'ye benzer ama daha resmî/vurgulu
尽管很累，他还是坚持工作。 [jǐnguǎn hěn lèi, tā háishi jiānchí gōngzuò]
如果明天下雨，我们就不去。 [rúguǒ míngtiān xiàyǔ, wǒmen jiù bú qù]
不管天气怎么样，我们都要去。 [bùguǎn tiānqì zěnmeyàng, wǒmen dōu yào qù]
footnotes_tr: The fundamental difference between 即使 and 不管/无论: 即使 addresses ONE (usually extreme) hypothesis, while 不管/无论 covers ALL possibilities (usually with interrogative words).

tables.caption_tr: Common Patterns with 即使
rows: 即使很晚，我也要打电话给他。 [jíshǐ hěn wǎn, wǒ yě yào dǎ diànhuà gěi tā]
即使他道歉，我也不原谅他。 [jíshǐ tā dàoqiàn, wǒ yě bù yuánliàng tā]
即使没人帮忙，他也会完成的。 [jíshǐ méi rén bāngmáng, tā yě huì wánchéng de]
即使给我钱，我也不会去。 [jíshǐ gěi wǒ qián, wǒ yě bú huì qù]
即使他是老板，也是要遵守规则的。 [jíshǐ tā shì lǎobǎn, yě shì yào zūnshǒu guīzé de]

tables.caption_tr: Subject Position in 即使 Sentences
rows: 即使我很累，我也要去。 [jíshǐ wǒ hěn lèi, wǒ yě yào qù]
即使 tüm cümlenin en başında; iki yan cümlede de aynı özne (我) tekrarlanır
Aynı özne, 即使 öznenin arkasında
我即使很累，也要去。 [wǒ jíshǐ hěn lèi, yě yào qù]
即使 öznenin (我) hemen arkasına da gelebilir; anlam değişmez
即使老师不在，学生也要认真上课。 [jíshǐ lǎoshī bú zài, xuésheng yě yào rènzhēn shàngkè]
İki yan cümlede farklı özneler varsa, 即使 mutlaka cümlenin en başında olmalı
也 ikinci yan cümlede ÖZNEDEN SONRA, FİİLDEN ÖNCE sabit konumda bulunur
footnotes_tr: Using a comma between 即使 and 也 provides writing convenience for Turkish speakers, but it is not required in Chinese.

ji-you.intro_tr: The 既...又... (jì...yòu...) structure is a formal-weighted conjunction pattern used to express two characteristics or actions that are valid simultaneously about a subject, meaning 'both... and...'. The A and B parts are usually disyllabic adjectives or verb phrases and must be in the same polarity (both positive or both negative); opposite-meaning adjectives cannot be used together in this structure. It closely resembles the 又...又... structure which is more common in spoken language, but 既...又... is preferred in written language, formal speeches, and reports. The structure is constructed as subject + 既 + A + 又 + B and can generally be used together with conjunctions like 所以 that indicate results.

tables.caption_tr: Basic Structure: 既...又...
rows: Özne + 既 + A + 又 + B
Öznenin aynı anda hem A hem de B özelliğine sahip olduğunu / hem A hem de B eylemini yaptığını belirtir
这件衣服既便宜又好看。
Zhè jiàn yīfu jì piányi yòu hǎokàn.
Bu kıyafet hem ucuz hem güzel (A: 便宜=ucuz, B: 好看=güzel)
Tā jì huì chànggē yòu huì tiàowǔ.
O hem şarkı söyleyebiliyor hem dans edebiliyor (fiil öbeği örneği)
Özne + 既 + 不/没 + A + 又 + 不/没 + B
Olumsuz biçim: ne A ne de B (ikisi de olumsuz olmalı)
footnotes_tr: A and B are usually disyllabic adjectives or verb phrases; usage with monosyllabic adjectives is rarer.
The A and B expressions between 既 and 又 must be in the same polarity (both positive / both negative).

tables.caption_tr: 既...又... vs 又...又...: Difference Table
rows: Nötr, günlük konuşma dilinde de yaygın
Rapor, makale, resmî konuşma, HSK4+ metinler
Genelde iki heceli sözcüklerle daha doğal
Tek veya iki heceli sözcüklerle rahat kullanılır
这个方案既经济又实用。
footnotes_tr: The two structures can be used interchangeably in most contexts; the choice usually depends on stylistic (formal/casual) preference.

tables.caption_tr: Frequently Used 既...又... Patterns
rows: 既符合规定又节省时间
jì fúhé guīdìng yòu jiéshěng shíjiān

tables.caption_tr: Frequently Made Mistakes
rows: 他既高又壮。 (Tā jì gāo yòu zhuàng.)
既...又... yapısında A ve B birbirine zıt anlamlı olamaz (高=uzun boylu vs 矮=kısa boylu çelişir); B, A ile uyumlu ikinci bir olumlu özellik olmalı.

İki taraf da aynı kutupta olmalı: ikisi de olumlu ya da ikisi de olumsuz olmalı, biri olumlu biri olumsuz karışık kullanılamaz.
既 A 又 B 后面加 了 随意使用
Bağlama göre 了 gerekliyse eklenir, gereksizse eklenmez
既...又... yapısı genellikle genel/kalıcı bir durumu anlatır; belirli bir olayı anlatmak için 了 gerekebilir ama otomatik eklenmemelidir.
既...又... yapısını tek heceli basit sıfatlarla aşırı gündelik cümlede kullanmak
Gündelik konuşmada 又...又... tercih edilir

adjective-reduplication.intro_tr: In Chinese, certain two-syllable adjectives (those with AB structure) are reduplicated in an AABB pattern to reinforce meaning and make the expression more vivid and descriptive; for example, the word 高兴[gāoxìng] (happy) becomes 高高兴兴[gāogāoxìngxìng]. This structure is particularly frequent in spoken language and descriptive narratives, giving the adjective a charming, emphatic, and sometimes slightly exaggerated tone. AABB reduplication in sentences is typically used with 的[de] as a predicate or with 地[de] as an adverbial modifier; without them (的/地), it cannot stand alone as a predicate. This structure is never used with degree adverbs like 很[hěn], 非常[fēicháng], because reduplication already serves the function of intensification. Not every two-syllable adjective can form an AABB pattern — only certain, frequently used adjectives enter this form, which is why the list must be memorized.

tables.caption_tr: AABB Reduplication Formation Rules
footnotes_tr: Note: With single-syllable adjectives, the pattern is only AA (not AABB). This page specifically focuses on the AB→AABB pattern.
The tone of the second syllable may often shift to a light (neutral) tone in everyday speech, e.g. gāogaoxìngxìng; however, full tones are shown in writing.

tables.caption_tr: List of Frequently Used AABB Adjectives
Usage Forms of AABB Structure in Sentences
rows: 他 高高兴兴 的[Tā gāogāoxìngxìng de]

'Tertemiz oda' — isimden önce 的 ile bağlanır.

Fiilden sonra 得 ile derece tümleci olarak kullanılır.

fractions-multiples.title_tr: Fractions, Percentages and Multiples (分之, 百分之, 倍)
fractions-multiples.intro_tr: In Chinese, fractions are expressed with the pattern "分母 (denominator) + 分之 [fēnzhī] + 分子 (numerator)", while percentages are expressed like a special fraction with a fixed denominator of 100 using the pattern "百分之 [bǎifēnzhī] + number". To express multiples, the word "倍 [bèi]" is used and typically carries the meaning of comparison (是...的几倍) or increase (增加/提高了...倍). An important pitfall: 倍 is not used in "decrease" statements; instead, 分之 or 百分之 is preferred. Furthermore, the expression "增加了一倍" means "%100 increase = becoming 2 times" as in Turkish, so in increase sentences constructed with 倍, the number is always calculated one less (N倍 increase = becoming (N+1) times). This page summarizes all patterns of fraction, percentage and multiple structures and common mistakes in table form.

tables.caption_tr: 1. Fraction Structure: 分母 + 分之 [fēnzhī] + 分子
footnotes_tr: Attention: Unlike Turkish, first the DENOMINATOR (分母), then 分之, then the NUMERATOR (分子) is said. E.g. 3/4 → 四(denominator)分之三(numerator).
分之 alone does not carry the meaning '...-de bir', it must always be used together with the denominator+分之+numerator pattern.

tables.caption_tr: 2. Percentages: 百分之 [bǎifēnzhī] + Number
footnotes_tr: 百分之百 is also used figuratively to mean 'definitely, completely': 我百分之百同意 (I definitely agree).

tables.caption_tr: 3. Expressing Multiples: 倍 [bèi] Usage Patterns
rows: A 是 B 的 N倍 (karşılaştırma)
这本书是那本的两倍贵。
Zhè běn shū shì nà běn de liǎng bèi guì.
Bu kitap onun iki katı pahalı.
A 是 B 的 N倍 (miktar)
Tā de niánlíng shì wǒ de sān bèi.
Onun yaşı benim yaşımın üç katı.
Üretim bir kat arttı (2 katına çıktı).
footnotes_tr: IMPORTANT: '增加/提高了N倍' = original amount + N times added, meaning the RESULT is (N+1) times. '增加了一倍' = became 2 times; '增加了两倍' = became 3 times.
倍 is used ONLY for increase/multiplication and comparison; it is not used in decrease descriptions (see Table 4).

tables.caption_tr: 4. Choosing the Correct Structure in Increase (增加) vs Decrease (减少) Expressions
footnotes_tr: Rule: '倍' is never used together with decrease verbs (减少, 降低, 下降). This is a typical source of error.

tables.caption_tr: 5. Verbs Commonly Used with Fractions/Percentages/Multiples
rows: 成本减少了百分之十五

bei-passive-full.title_tr: Passive Voice Full Scope (被 / 叫 / 让)
bei-passive-full.intro_tr: The simple pattern we learned in the basic lesson of 被 (bèi) passive structure expands at HSK4 level with 叫 (jiào) and 让 (ràng), and the rule that the sentence must be "fully comprehensive" comes into play: that is, writing just the verb is not enough, after the verb there must definitely be an additional element such as 了/过, a complement or an object. 被 has wide usage in written language and daily conversation, while 叫 and 让 are more preferred in spoken language, and in these two the specification of the agent (the one performing the action) is mandatory — whereas in 被 the agent can be omitted. This page summarizes in table form the differences of the three structures, the full sentence pattern, the mandatory complement types, the position of negation and aspect adverbs, and common mistakes.

tables.caption_tr: 被 (bèi) / 叫 (jiào) / 让 (ràng) Comparison Table
rows: Yazı dili + konuşma dili (en yaygın, nötr)
Yazılı metin, haberler, resmî anlatım, günlük konuşma
杯子被打破了。[Bēizi bèi dǎ pò le.] — Bardak kırıldı.
他叫狗咬了。[Tā jiào gǒu yǎo le.] — O, köpek tarafından ısırıldı.
Günlük sohbet, 叫 ile neredeyse aynı anlamda
书让他拿走了。[Shū ràng tā ná zǒu le.] — Kitabı o alıp götürdü.
Fiilden hemen önce 给 eklenerek vurgu yapılabilir
衣服被(他)给弄脏了。[Yīfu bèi (tā) gěi nòng zāng le.] — Kıyafet (onun tarafından) kirletildi.
footnotes_tr: 叫 and 让 are mostly used in unpleasant / unexpected events; 被 can be used in all types of events (neutral, positive, negative).
让 is also used as a causative structure with the meaning 'to allow / to make (someone do)'; it is distinguished from context.

tables.caption_tr: Full Sentence Pattern: Step-by-Step Structure
rows: 了 / 过 / sonuç tümleci / yön tümleci / miktar tümleci / nesne — en az biri şart
footnotes_tr: Example full sentence: 这本书被他拿走了。[Zhè běn shū bèi tā ná zǒu le.] — He took this book away.
Saying only '被他拿' is incomplete from a grammatical perspective; a complement is absolutely necessary.

tables.caption_tr: Required Elements After the Verb (Full Scope Rule)
rows: 花瓶被打破了。[Huāpíng bèi dǎ pò le.]
这个问题被讨论过。[Zhège wèntí bèi tǎolùn guo.]
衣服被雨淋湿了。[Yīfu bèi yǔ lín shī le.]
钱包被小偷拿走了。[Qiánbāo bèi xiǎotōu ná zǒu le.]
他被老师批评了一顿。[Tā bèi lǎoshī pīpíng le yí dùn.]
O öğretmen tarafından bir güzel eleştirildi.
他被选为班长。[Tā bèi xuǎn wéi bānzhǎng.]
footnotes_tr: At least ONE of the elements in this table must be present in the sentence; otherwise the sentence is considered incomplete from a grammatical perspective.

tables.caption_tr: Position of Negation and Aspect Adverbs
rows: 衣服还没被洗干净。[Yīfu hái méi bèi xǐ gānjìng.]
他不会被开除的。[Tā bú huì bèi kāichú de.]
他可能被老板骂了。[Tā kěnéng bèi lǎobǎn mà le.]
问题已经被解决了。[Wèntí yǐjīng bèi jiějué le.]
他总是被人误会。[Tā zǒngshì bèi rén wùhuì.]
footnotes_tr: Rule: Adverbs and negation words always come BEFORE 被/叫/让, never immediately before the verb or at the end of the sentence.

tables.caption_tr: Common Mistakes (Wrong vs Correct)
rows: ❌ 书被他拿。[Shū bèi tā ná.]
✅ 书被他拿走了。[Shū bèi tā ná zǒu le.]
Fiilden sonra mutlaka ek unsur (走了) olmalı.
❌ 他叫骂了一顿。[Tā jiào mà le yí dùn.]
✅ 他叫老板骂了一顿。[Tā jiào lǎobǎn mà le yí dùn.]
叫 ve 让'da fail asla atlanamaz; sadece 被'de atlanabilir.
✅ 衣服没被洗干净。[Yīfu méi bèi xǐ gānjìng.]
没 her zaman 被'den önce gelmeli.
✅ 他不会被开除。[Tā bú huì bèi kāichú.]
Kip zarfları (不会, 可能 vb.) 被'den önce gelmeli, fiilin önüne değil.
被 ile olumlu/nötr olaylarda gereksiz kaçınma
Genelde doğru ama dikkat: 被 sadece olumsuz olaylarda değil, resmî/nötr olaylarda da (özellikle yazı dilinde) kullanılabilir.
他被选为代表。[Tā bèi xuǎn wéi dàibiǎo.] — O temsilci seçildi.
被, öğrencilerin sandığının aksine sadece kötü olaylarla sınırlı değildir.
footnotes_tr: 叫/让, on the other hand, are almost always used with negative/unfortunate events; they are not preferred in positive formal expressions.

examples.target: 我的钱包被小偷偷走了。
examples.reading: Wǒ de qiánbāo bèi xiǎotōu tōu zǒu le.
examples.translation_tr: My wallet was stolen by a thief.
examples.note_tr: 被 + agent (小偷) + verb (偷) + directional complement (走) + le. There must be an additional element after the verb (走了).

examples.target: 这本书被他借走了，还没还回来。
examples.reading: Zhè běn shū bèi tā jiè zǒu le, hái méi huán huílai.
examples.translation_tr: This book was borrowed by him, it has not been returned yet.
examples.note_tr: 被 sentence: recipient + 被 + agent + verb + complement.

examples.target: 他叫老板骂了一顿。
examples.reading: Tā jiào lǎobǎn mà le yí dùn.
examples.translation_tr: He was thoroughly scolded by his boss.
examples.note_tr: 叫 is used in spoken language; the agent (老板) can never be omitted.

examples.target: 衣服让雨淋湿了。
examples.reading: Yīfu ràng yǔ lín shī le.
examples.translation_tr: The clothes were soaked by the rain.
examples.note_tr: With 让 the agent is also mandatory; the resultative complement 湿 comes after the verb.

examples.target: 窗户被刮破了，谁也不知道是什么时候的事。

examples.note_tr: With 被 the agent can be omitted: 被 + verb + complement, if the agent is uncertain or insignificant.

examples.target: 这件事不会被大家忘记的。
examples.reading: Zhè jiàn shì bú huì bèi dàjiā wàngjì de.
examples.translation_tr: This event will not be forgotten by everyone.
examples.note_tr: Auxiliary verb/possibility adverb (不会) comes BEFORE 被, not before the verb.

examples.target: 作业还没被他做完呢。
examples.reading: Zuòyè hái méi bèi tā zuò wán ne.
examples.translation_tr: The homework has not been finished by him yet.
examples.note_tr: Negation 没(有) always comes BEFORE 被/叫/让, never written separately before the verb.

examples.target: 小明让妈妈说了一顿，心里很难过。
examples.reading: Xiǎomíng ràng māma shuō le yí dùn, xīnli hěn nánguò.
examples.translation_tr: Little Ming was thoroughly scolded by his mother, he felt very sad inside.
examples.note_tr: 让 + agent + verb + 了 + quantity complement (一顿).

zhihao.intro_tr: 只好[zhǐhǎo] is an adverb meaning "helpless, forced to, with no other choice"; it expresses that the speaker reluctantly chooses an action because there are no other options. It is generally used in the second half of a sentence to convey "for this reason, I had no choice but to do/am doing this," after describing an obstacle, negative situation, or unexpected development. It follows the pattern: Subject + 只好 + verb phrase, and it has no negative form (不只好). It is semantically similar to 只能, 不得不, and 只有...才, but differs in grammar and emotional tone; the subtle differences between them are compared in a table on this page.

tables.caption_tr: 只好[zhǐhǎo] Basic Sentence Structure
rows: Sebep cümlesi (，) + Özne + 只好 + Sonuç
Hasta olduğu için mecburen izin aldı.
只好 + Fiil + 了 (tamamlanmış çaresiz eylem)
既然[jìrán]你不同意[bù tóngyì]，我只好[zhǐhǎo]一个人去[yí gè rén qù]了。
Madem sen kabul etmiyorsun, mecburen tek başıma gittim.
footnotes_tr: 只好 always comes immediately before the verb, after the subject; it is not used with other adverbs (such as very, still, etc.).

tables.caption_tr: Comparison of Expressions Similar to 只好
rows: Çaresiz kalıp gönülsüzce tercih etme (duygusal ton)
没有钱[méiyǒu qián]，只好走路[zǒulù]回家[huí jiā]。 — Param olmadığı için çaresiz yürüyerek eve gittim.
En yaygın ve doğal günlük kullanım; hafif hayal kırıklığı içerir.
Sadece bu seçeneğin mümkün olması (daha nötr, objektif kısıtlama)
现在只能[zhǐnéng]等[děng]。 — Şu an sadece bekleyebiliriz.
Duygusal gönülsüzlük vurgusu 只好'ya göre daha zayıftır.
Mecbur kalmak, başka çare olmaması (daha güçlü/resmî vurgu)
他不得不[bùdébù]辞职[cízhí]。 — İstifa etmek zorunda kaldı.
Yazı dilinde ve resmî bağlamda sık; genelde olumsuz/ciddi durumlar için.
只有[zhǐyǒu]努力[nǔlì]才能[cáinéng]成功[chénggōng]。 — Ancak çalışırsan başarılı olabilirsin.
Farklı gramer yapısı: koşul-sonuç bildirir, çaresizlik anlatmaz.

tables.caption_tr: Rules to Note When Using 只好
rows: 不只好 şeklinde bir kullanım gramatik olarak hatalıdır; olumsuzluk anlamı fiil kısmında verilir
只好[zhǐhǎo]不去[bú qù] (doğru) — çaresiz gitmemek zorunda kaldım.
只好 sadece anlatım (bildirme) cümlelerinde geçer, buyruk cümlesi kuramaz
Genelde bir sebep/engel cümlesinden sonra gelir
因为/由于/既然/没有办法 gibi ifadelerle bağlanan bir öncül cümle beklenir
Geçmişte alınmış çaresiz bir karar anlatılırken 只好...了 kalıbı tercih edilir
他只好[zhǐhǎo]接受[jiēshòu]了。 — Çaresiz kabul etti.
İlk cümlede durum/sorun anlatılır, 只好 ikinci cümlede sonucu bildirir
钱不够[qián búgòu]，只好[zhǐhǎo]少买[shǎo mǎi]一点儿[yìdiǎnr]。

tables.caption_tr: Common Fixed Phrases Used with 只好
rows: Çaresiz böyle olmak, başka çare kalmamak
İdare etmek zorunda kalmak, olanla yetinmek
footnotes_tr: These phrases are fixed expressions frequently seen after 只好 in spoken language; they usually emphasize the helplessness at the end of the sentence.

examples.target: 医生说我不能吃辣的，我只好放弃我最爱的火锅。

qilai-extended.title_tr: 起来 (qǐlai) Extended Usages: 看起来, 想起来 and Others
qilai-extended.intro_tr: 起来[qǐlai] is actually a directional complement verb meaning "to rise, to get up"; however, the pattern Verb/Adjective + 起来 in Chinese very frequently departs from the concrete directional meaning and shifts toward ABSTRACT/EXTENDED meanings. This extended usage has four fundamental functions: (1) when used with a perception verb, to convey the impression "...looks/seems..." (看起来[kànqǐlai]); (2) to express that an action suddenly began (哭起来[kūqǐlai] = to start crying); (3) to describe something coming to one's mind/memory (想起来[xiǎngqǐlai] = to remember); (4) at the beginning of a sentence, to introduce a topic for discussion with the meaning "when it comes to..., when..., upon reflection..." (说起来[shuōqǐlai], 算起来[suànqǐlai]). At HSK4 level, all four of these usages are very frequently encountered and form an indispensable part of everyday conversation.

fouze-buran.title_tr: 否则[fǒuzé] / 不然[bùrán] — 'Otherwise, Or Else'
fouze-buran.intro_tr: 否则[fǒuzé] and 不然[bùrán] are conjunctions in Chinese meaning 'otherwise, or else' and always appear at the BEGINNING of the second of two sentences: first a suggestion, warning, or current situation is stated, and then if this does not occur, the undesired consequence that would result is connected with 否则/不然. These two are semantically identical; the only difference is style — 否则 is more formal/written, while 不然 is more common in everyday spoken language. Generally, after this conjunction, the following sentence contains words like 会[huì] or 就[jiù] that express consequence/possibility. 不然 also frequently appears as 要不然[yàobùrán] and its shortened form 要不[yàobù]; these carry the same meaning but are even more intimate/conversational in tone. Structurally, 否则/不然 can be thought of as a shortened, flowing version of the longer conditional '如果不...就...' sentence.

conger.title_tr: 从而 (cóng'ér): "Thus, By Means of This"
conger.intro_tr: 从而[cóng'ér] is a conjunction frequently used in formal and written Chinese and corresponds to Turkish expressions such as 'thus, by means of this, consequently'. It connects two sentences: the first sentence describes an action, method, or change; the second sentence after 从而 indicates the result or purpose achieved THANKS TO this first action. 从而 is not used in everyday conversation but rather in formal texts such as news, articles, and reports; in everyday conversation, 所以[suǒyǐ] is preferred instead. An important rule: after 从而, the subject is usually not repeated, because the subject of both sentences is the same. On this page, you will find the structure of 从而, its differences with similar conjunctions, and frequently used patterns in table form.

tables.caption_tr: Basic Sentence Structure of 从而
rows: İlk eylem, ikinci eylemin gerçekleşmesinin yolunu veya sebebini oluşturur; 从而'den sonraki eylem, öncekinin doğal sonucu veya ulaşılan amacıdır.
Cümle1，从而 + 使/让 + Nesne + Sonuç

anzhao-genju.title_tr: 按照[ànzhào] / 根据[gēnjù] — 'according to, in accordance with'
anzhao-genju.intro_tr: 按照[ànzhào] and 根据[gēnjù] are formal prepositions (介词[jiècí]) in Turkish that mean "according to" or "in accordance with" and are typically used at the beginning of a sentence. Both indicate that an action occurs based on a rule, plan, document, data, or someone's word. 按照[ànzhào] emphasizes more the meaning of "acting in accordance with a rule/plan," while 根据[gēnjù] carries more the meaning of "drawing conclusions based on concrete data/evidence" and for this reason appears very frequently in academic, official, and news language. The structure is typically "按照/根据 + noun phrase, + sentence" and frequently appears in reading passages at HSK5 level, in news, and in official texts. Although these two words can be used interchangeably in most contexts, there are subtle differences in meaning and collocation (collocation).

yu-preposition.title_tr: 于 (yú): Written Language Preposition (位于, 等于, 在于)
yu-preposition.intro_tr: 于 [yú] is a monosyllabic preposition that comes from classical/literary Chinese and is frequently used in modern written language (official documents, news, academic articles). It can single-handedly assume the functions of prepositions like 在, 向, 给, 比, 对 in spoken language; but in everyday speech it is almost never used alone. Its actual usage pattern is by being added immediately after a verb or adjective to form FIXED BINARY PATTERNS like 位于[wèiyú], 等于[děngyú], 在于[zàiyú], 属于[shǔyú], 忙于[mángyú] — therefore, it is most practical to learn 于 not as a free grammar rule but as a list of patterns that must be memorized. At HSK5 level, patterns like 位于, 等于, 在于, 属于, 忙于, 善于, 有利于 are particularly frequently tested.

bushi-ershi.intro_tr: 不是...而是... (bú shì...ér shì...) is a very useful correction structure that means "A is not, but rather/truly B". The speaker first rejects false or misunderstood information with 不是, then presents the correct fact with 而是. The 而 (ér) here is a conjunction frequently seen in written language and emphasizes the contrast by adding the meaning "but rather, on the contrary". This structure can be used with nouns, adjectives, verbs, and even complete sentences; it is very common in daily speech as well as formal writing. Note: 不 (bù) changes to the second tone before 是 (shì), which is in the fourth tone, and is pronounced/written as bú shì — this rule applies throughout the pattern.

tables.caption_tr: Basic Structure: 不是...而是...
rows: A + 不是 X，而是 Y
A bú shì X, ér shì Y

bú shì X, ér shì Y
不是 X，是 Y (而 düşmüş, kısa konuşma biçimi)
S + 不是 + V/Adj，而是 + V/Adj
S bú shì V/Adj, ér shì V/Adj
footnotes_tr: 不 (bù) changes to the 2nd tone before 是 (shì), which is in the 4th tone: the writing does not change but in pronunciation it is called 'bú shì'.
而是 can also be used alone at the beginning of a sentence; in this case, the preceding 不是 part has already appeared in the previous sentence or question.

jiaru-jiashi.title_tr: Formal Condition: 假如[jiǎrú] / 假使[jiǎshǐ]
jiaru-jiashi.intro_tr: 假如[jiǎrú] and 假使[jiǎshǐ] are conditional conjunctions used in written language and formal speeches, meaning "if, let us suppose that, let us say" in Turkish. They are almost the same in meaning as 如果[rúguǒ], but not used in daily conversation; they are preferred in articles, reports, formal speeches, legal texts, and literary narratives. They are generally used to express situations that have not yet occurred, hypothetical, or non-real situations, and are often seen together with adverbs 就[jiù], 那么[nàme], or literary 便[biàn] in the result clause. 假使[jiǎshǐ] is even more formal than 假如[jiǎrú] and is specific to written language; it is almost never used in daily conversation. On this page, the structure of the two conjunctions, their degrees of formality, accompanying adverbs, and common mistakes are summarized in tables.

suizhe.intro_tr: 随着[suízhe] is a formal particle/conjunction that indicates that one event or change occurs simultaneously with or is dependent on another event; it means '... together with', '...-while', '...-in parallel with'. Appearing at the beginning of a sentence, it creates a 'background condition' clause: 随着[suízhe] + Noun Phrase/Clause, and in the main clause separated by a comma, consequences/changes are usually expressed with adverbs like 也[yě], 都[dōu], 逐渐[zhújiàn], 不断[búduàn], or 越来越[yuèláiyuè]. 随着[suízhe] itself is not a verb, cannot be a predicate on its own, and must be followed by a noun phrase (usually a structure ending with 的[de]). It is an important pattern at the HSK5 level, frequently used in written language, news articles, formal speeches, and academic narratives. It should not be confused with 跟着[gēnzhe] (literally following someone) and 随[suí] (to follow/comply).

rows: 随着 + İsim Tamlaması，主语 + (也/都/逐渐/不断) + Yüklem

faner.title_tr: 反而 (fǎn'ér): "Completely Opposite, Contrary, Contrary to Expectations"
faner.intro_tr: 反而[fǎn'ér] is an adverb meaning "completely opposite, contrary, contrary to expectations" and emphasizes that a situation contrary to the expected result occurs. Usually, a situation or effort is described first (for example, an action is performed or not performed), then with 反而[fǎn'ér], an unexpected, opposite result is reported. Because it is an adverb, it always comes AFTER the subject and BEFORE the verb; it cannot be placed at the beginning of the sentence. It is frequently used with patterns like 不但...没/不...反而... or between two independent subordinate clauses. In terms of meaning, it is similar to 却[què], but 反而[fǎn'ér] emphasizes the idea of "the opposite of what was expected, a result in the opposite direction" more strongly; it is not just a simple contrast, but describes a development logically in the opposite direction.

yilai.intro_tr: 以来[yǐlái] literally means 'having come to here,' but in practice it is a temporal word corresponding to the Turkish expression '...-den beri' (since...). It is used to describe a situation, action, or change that starts from a certain point in time (in the past) and continues up to the moment of speech (the present). It typically forms the pattern '从/自 + time + 以来' together with 从[cóng] or 自[zì], and in the main part of the sentence it is supported by adverbs indicating continuity such as 一直[yìzhí], 都[dōu], and 已经[yǐjīng]. 以来[yǐlái] always expresses a span of time FROM PAST TO PRESENT; it is not used for future tense or for a single, momentary event. It appears very frequently in written language and formal narratives, and is also used in daily conversation especially when talking about long-term changes.

tables.caption_tr: Basic Structure: 从/自 + Time + 以来

从/自 + zaman + 以来, + Özne + 一直/都 + Yüklem

cóng shàngzhōu yǐlái, tā yìzhí hěn máng.
Geçen haftadan beri o hep meşgul.
footnotes_tr: 从[cóng] is more neutral and common in spoken language; 自[zì] is more formal/specific to written language.
The use of time word + 以来 without 从/自 is generally seen in formal written language (news articles, essays).

jiang-formal-ba.title_tr: 将 (jiāng): Official 把 Structure and Future Tense Marker
jiang-formal-ba.intro_tr: 将 [jiāng] in modern Chinese has two distinct but interrelated functions: first, to be used in written language (书面语) as the official/literary equivalent of the 把 [bǎ] structure that places the object before the verb; second, to serve as an official future tense marker that expresses an event that will occur in the future (将/将要/即将/将会). 将 is generally preferred in news bulletins, official announcements, reports, and written documents; in everyday speech, 把 and 要/会/快要...了 are used respectively in place of these functions. In the 将 structure, just as in 把, the verb cannot be left bare; something must follow the verb—necessarily a complement, 了, or another element. On this page, both functions of 将 are summarized in separate tables, together with example pattern verbs and common errors.

tables.caption_tr: Comparison of 将 [jiāng] Structure with 把 [bǎ] Structure
rows: Haber, rapor, resmî belge, yazılı metin
我们将会议延期。[Wǒmen jiāng huìyì yánqī.]
我们把会议延期了。[Wǒmen bǎ huìyì yánqī le.]
Çok nadir; genelde farklı yapıya geçilir
把 + Nesne + V了没有? gibi yaygın
Aynı cümlede 是否 ile birlikte
footnotes_tr: The 将 structure is hardly ever used in spoken language; 把, on the other hand, is valid in both written and spoken language.

tables.caption_tr: Future Tense Markers with 将 [jiāng]
rows: Resmî, yakın veya uzak gelecekte olacak bir durum
大会将于下周举行。[Dàhuì jiāng yú xiàzhōu jǔxíng.]
将'dan biraz daha vurgulu, planlanmış gelecek
他将要出国留学。[Tā jiāngyào chūguó liúxué.]
火车即将进站。[Huǒchē jíjiāng jìnzhàn.]
经济将会好转。[Jīngjì jiānghuì hǎozhuǎn.]
他快要到了。[Tā kuàiyào dào le.]
footnotes_tr: Patterns based on 将 are preferred in formal speech/writing, while 快要...了 is preferred in everyday language.

tables.caption_tr: 将 + Object + Verb + Obligatory Complement Patterns
rows: 将 + O + V + 成/为/好/完
我们将教室布置成了会场。[Wǒmen jiāng jiàoshì bùzhìchéngle huìchǎng.]
将 + O + V + 起来/上去/下来
他将信件收了起来。[Tā jiāng xìnjiàn shōule qǐlai.]
政府将该地区划为保护区了。[Zhèngfǔ jiāng gāi dìqū huàwéi bǎohùqū le.]
将 + O + V + 给 + Kişi
我们将奖金分给了每一位员工。[Wǒmen jiāng jiǎngjīn fēngěile měi yí wèi yuángōng.]
将 + O + V + 在/到 + Yer/Zaman
他将会议改在明天下午。[Tā jiāng huìyì gǎi zài míngtiān xiàwǔ.]
footnotes_tr: This rule is exactly the same as the 把 structure: the verb can never be left bare (naked).

tables.caption_tr: Frequently Used Official Pattern Verbs with 将 [jiāng]
rows: 他们将这次合作视为重要机会。[Tāmen jiāng zhècì hézuò shìwéi zhòngyào jīhuì.]
人们将这种现象称为'温室效应'。[Rénmen jiāng zhèzhǒng xiànxiàng chēngwéi 'wēnshì xiàoyìng'.]

这项政策将纳入新法规。[Zhè xiàng zhèngcè jiāng nàrù xīn fǎguī.]
参会人数将近一千人。[Cānhuì rénshù jiāngjìn yìqiān rén.]
将来我想当医生。[Jiānglái wǒ xiǎng dāng yīshēng.]

tables.caption_tr: Common Mistakes
rows: Fiilden sonra yalnızca 了 yetmez; sonuç tümleci gibi bir unsur da gerekir.
你把作业做了吗？ / 作业你做了吗？
将 günlük konuşmada soru cümlelerinde neredeyse hiç kullanılmaz; 把 veya konu-yorum yapısı tercih edilir.
我要去北京。 / 我会去北京。
Basit gelecek niyet günlük konuşmada 要/会 ile ifade edilir; 将 daha çok resmî duyurularda kullanılır.
将 ile emir cümlesi kurmak: 将门关上！
Emir/rica cümlelerinde 把 kullanılır, 将 kullanılmaz.
footnotes_tr: 将 is hardly ever used in imperative, question, and request sentences in everyday spoken language; in these contexts, 把 is always preferred.

suo-structure.title_tr: 所 (suǒ) Structure: 所+V, 所谓, 所有
suo-structure.intro_tr: 所 (suǒ) is a grammar particle frequently encountered in written language, which has no meaning on its own but nominalizes a verb when placed before it. Its most common usage is the pattern 所 + Verb (+ 的), which adds the meaning 'the thing done/said/thought'; this structure is generally linked to a noun with 的. 所谓 'so-called, said to be', 所有 'all, entire' and the formal passive structure 为...所... are also patterns derived from the same 所 character but with different functions. These structures are preferred in written language rather than daily conversation, in news texts and formal narratives; in spoken language, 所 can often be omitted and the sentence remains correct.

yiji.intro_tr: 以及[yǐjí] is a conjunction used in formal written language and means 'and', 'together with', 'in addition to'. Although 和[hé] in spoken language serves a similar function, 以及[yǐjí] is generally preferred to connect the LAST element in long lists, while commas (、) are used between preceding elements. 以及[yǐjí] can connect not only nouns but also noun phrases, verb phrases, and even entire clauses; in this way, it has a wider range of use than 和[hé], which can only connect nouns. Additionally, there is usually a sense of importance/priority order between elements connected with 以及[yǐjí] — the initial elements are perceived as the main component, while the element after 以及[yǐjí] is understood as supplementary/complementary information. It frequently appears in official reports, news articles, academic writings, and meeting minutes.

degree-complements-advanced.title_tr: Advanced Degree Complements: 得很 / 极了 / 死了
degree-complements-advanced.intro_tr: 得很[de hěn], 极了[jí le] and 死了[sǐ le] are advanced degree complements used to emphasize strongly the degree of an adjective or emotion-indicating verb (e.g. 高兴, 累, 饿) with expressions like "very, extremely, really to death". These structures appear at HSK5 level and unlike the basic pattern 很+adjective, they are added AFTER the adjective; furthermore, 很 is not added before them again and they cannot form negative constructions. 得很 is neutral to moderate intensity, 极了 is stronger and appears in both written and spoken language, while 死了 is the most exaggerated and almost exclusively in everyday colloquial speech. This page summarizes in table form the usage rules of all three structures, complete conjugations with common adjectives, words that naturally match with 死了, common mistakes, and other extreme degree patterns similar to these three (得不得了, 得要命, 透了).

tables.caption_tr: General Comparison of the Three Structures
rows: Nötr; hem yazı hem konuşma dilinde yaygın
Hem yazı hem konuşma dilinde; resmî metinlerde de görülür
Neredeyse tamamen günlük konuşma dili; şaka/abartı tonu taşır
footnotes_tr: All three structures generally cannot form negatives: '不好得很/不好极了/不好死了' is incorrect.
Additionally, 很 is not added before the adjective: '很好得很' is incorrect, only '好得很' is correct.

tables.caption_tr: Complete Conjugation Table with Common Adjectives

漂亮极了 piàoliang jí le
高兴得很 gāoxìng de hěn

高兴死了 gāoxìng sǐ le
难受得很 nánshòu de hěn
难受极了 nánshòu jí le
难受死了 nánshòu sǐ le
footnotes_tr: Cells marked with △ are grammatically possible but rarely heard in natural speech.
死了, by its nature, sounds more natural with adjectives indicating physical discomfort or strong emotions.

tables.caption_tr: Commonly Used Words That Naturally Match with 死了
footnotes_tr: These patterns are similar to exaggerated expressions in Turkish like 'dying from/really X-ing to death', they have no relation to actual death.

她说得很好 (sadece bir yapı seç)
得很 ile fiil tümleci 得 (说得好) aynı cümlede karıştırılmamalı; ikisi farklı yapılardır.

duiyu-guanyu.title_tr: 对于 [duìyú] / 关于 [guānyú]: '... about / regarding'
duiyu-guanyu.intro_tr: 对于[duìyú] and 关于[guānyú] are two formal prepositions in Turkish meaning "about, concerning, regarding" and are generally used at the beginning of a sentence or noun phrase. 关于[guānyú] conveys more of a "topic/title" meaning and can generally only appear at the beginning of a sentence; moreover, it is frequently used in noun phrases such as book titles, reports, and news (关于...的 + noun). 对于[duìyú], on the other hand, expresses an attitude, opinion, or evaluation toward something; it can be used both at the beginning of a sentence and after the subject, and when combined with 来说[láishuō]/而言[éryán] it can also give the meaning "...from the perspective of." Although the two can be interchangeable in some sentences, the position restrictions and nuance differences are a distinction frequently tested at the HSK5 level. On this page, the usage rules, position differences, and frequently used patterns of both words are summarized in tables.

bushi-jiushi.title_tr: 不是...就是... — "Either ... Or ..." / "If not ... Then ..."
bushi-jiushi.intro_tr: The 不是...就是... [búshì...jiùshì...] pattern is used to express that one of two possibilities is definitely valid, and there is no third possibility: "either A or B", "if not A, then B". It is usually used when describing repeated, habitual situations and often carries a slight complaint, grumble, or negative tone (e.g., "always either does this or does that"). The structure is symmetric: 不是 and 就是 connect elements of the same grammatical type (two verbs, two nouns, two adjectives, two clauses). The difference between 不是...就是... and 要么...要么... is important: the former describes existing/realized situations, while the latter describes options/choices not yet realized. Additionally, this structure should not be confused with 不是...而是... ("... not, but rather ...") which is completely different in meaning.

tables.caption_tr: Basic Structure: 不是 A 就是 B
rows: 主语 + 不是 + V1 就是 + V2
他不是睡觉就是看电视。 [Tā búshì shuìjiào jiùshì kàn diànshì.]
O ya uyur ya da televizyon izler.
主语 + 不是 + N1 就是 + N2
来的人不是老师就是学生。 [Lái de rén búshì lǎoshī jiùshì xuésheng.]
Gelen kişi ya öğretmen ya da öğrencidir.
主语 + 不是 + Adj1 就是 + Adj2
天气不是太热就是太冷。 [Tiānqì búshì tài rè jiùshì tài lěng.]
Hava ya çok sıcak ya da çok soğuk.
主语 + 不是 + 在处所1 就是 + 在处所2
他不是在公司就是在家。 [Tā búshì zài gōngsī jiùshì zài jiā.]
O ya şirkette ya da evdedir.
不是 + S1 就是 + S2
不是他迟到就是我迟到。 [Búshì tā chídào jiùshì wǒ chídào.]
Ya o geç kalır ya da ben geç kalırım.

tables.caption_tr: 不是...就是... vs 要么...要么... vs 不是...而是...
rows: Ya A ya B (gerçekleşmiş/alışılmış durum, çoğu zaman şikâyet tonu)
他不是忙就是累,没时间陪我。 [Tā búshì máng jiùshì lèi, méi shíjiān péi wǒ.]
Ya A ya B (henüz seçilmemiş, seçenek/tercih sunma)
要么你去,要么我去。 [Yàome nǐ qù, yàome wǒ qù.]
这不是苹果而是梨。 [Zhè búshì píngguǒ érshì lí.]

tables.caption_tr: Frequently Used Patterns and Semantic Tones
rows: búshì A jiùshì B, méiyǒu C
Ya A ya B, C diye bir şey yok
İki uç arasında hep bir sorun olduğunu belirtme
不是你的错就是我的错
búshì nǐ de cuò jiùshì wǒ de cuò
Ya senin hatan ya benim hatam

youyu-daozhi.title_tr: 由于[yóuyú] / 导致[dǎozhì] — 'Due to / Lead to'
youyu-daozhi.intro_tr: 由于[yóuyú] and 导致[dǎozhì] are two written/formal (书面语[shūmiànyǔ]) expressions used to create cause-effect relationships in Chinese, which you will frequently encounter at the HSK5 level. 由于[yóuyú] is a conjunction that introduces a reason with the meaning 'because of, due to' and is generally used at the beginning of a sentence as a more formal alternative to 因为[yīnwèi]. 导致[dǎozhì], on the other hand, is a verb with the meaning 'to lead to, to cause' and is used almost always to introduce a NEGATIVE/UNWANTED result — therefore, 导致[dǎozhì] is not naturally used with positive results such as 'success, happiness'. These two structures can be used sequentially as you generally see them together: 由于 + CAUSE, 导致 + RESULT. On this page, you will find both structural patterns and tables showing the differences with similar words like 因为, 造成, 使, 引起.

tables.caption_tr: 由于[yóuyú] — Basic Structural Patterns
rows: 由于 + Sebep，主语 + 结果
En yaygın kalıp; 由于 cümlenin başında yer alır, virgülden sonra sonuç gelir.
由于下雨，比赛取消了。 (Yóuyú xiàyǔ, bǐsài qǔxiāo le.)
由于 + Sebep，(所以) + 结果
所以[suǒyǐ] eklemek isteğe bağlıdır, resmî yazıda genelde atlanır.
由于疫情，(所以)学校暂时关闭。
主语 + 由于 + Sebep + 而 + 结果
Çok resmî/yazınsal düzeyde, 而[ér] ile bağlanan tek cümle yapısı.
他由于身体原因而辞职了。
由于 doğrudan bir isim/isim öbeği de alabilir, tam cümle şart değil.
由于经济原因，工厂停产了。
footnotes_tr: 由于[yóuyú] always introduces the CAUSE; in the result part, conjunctions like 因此[yīncǐ], 从而[cóng'ér] can also be used.

tables.caption_tr: 由于[yóuyú] vs 因为[yīnwèi] Comparison
rows: Nötr, hem yazı hem konuşma dili
因为...所以... çok sık birlikte kullanılır
Kullanılmaz (由于 tek başına cümle olamaz)
因为 tek başına cevap olabilir: '你为什么迟到？' '因为堵车。'
Daha az doğal, genelde tam cümle ister

tables.caption_tr: 导致[dǎozhì] — Usage Patterns
rows: 原因 + 导致 + 结果(olumsuz)
导致 bir fiildir; özne SEBEP, nesne SONUÇtur. Sonuç neredeyse daima olumsuz/istenmeyen bir şeydir.
污染导致了气候变化。 (Wūrǎn dǎozhì le qìhòu biànhuà.)
由于 ile 导致 birlikte kullanılabilir: sebep 由于 ile, sonuç 导致 ile tanıtılır.
由于操作失误，导致了系统崩溃。
'...-e yol açan neden' anlamında isim tamlaması olarak kullanılabilir.
导致事故的原因还在调查中。
Haber/rapor dilinde çok sık görülen tipik cümle kalıbı.
这一决定导致了公司股价下跌。
footnotes_tr: 导致[dǎozhì] typically reports a completed result together with 'le[了]': 导致了...
导致 is definitely not naturally used with positive results (success, happiness, etc.); for this, 使[shǐ] or 带来[dàilái] is preferred.

tables.caption_tr: Verbs Meaning 'To Cause': 导致 / 造成 / 引起 / 使 Comparison
rows: 吸烟导致肺癌。 (Xīyān dǎozhì fèi'ái.)
地震造成了严重损失。 (Dìzhèn zàochéng le yánzhòng sǔnshī.)
这个新闻引起了大家的关注。 (Zhège xīnwén yǐnqǐ le dàjiā de guānzhù.)
Nötr, hem olumlu hem olumsuz olabilir
这个消息使我很高兴。 (Zhège xiāoxi shǐ wǒ hěn gāoxìng.)
footnotes_tr: 导致 and 造成 are very similar to each other; 造成 is more often preferred in concrete/measurable losses (money, loss of life), while 导致 is preferred in more abstract/general negative results.

tables.caption_tr: Frequently Used Expressions with 由于[yóuyú]

zhi-attributive.title_tr: 之 (zhī): In Written Language 的 — 百分之, 之间, 之一 Patterns
zhi-attributive.intro_tr: 之 (zhī) is a very ancient particle inherited from Classical Chinese that performs the possessive/attributive function corresponding to 的 (de) in modern spoken language within written language (书面语). Its most important difference from 的 is that it cannot be used freely in every noun phrase; it is valid only in certain fixed phrases, formal expressions, and fixed structures. The most common usages you will encounter in daily life are percentage expressions (百分之十 "%10"), fractions (三分之一 "1/3"), place-time patterns (之间, 之后, 之前 etc.), and the 之一 structure meaning "...one of". At HSK5 level, recognizing 之 is necessary for understanding formal texts, news, and idioms; however, do not attempt to use 之 freely instead of 的 in your own sentences — it is only used in the patterns below.

tables.caption_tr: 之 = 的: Possession/Attribution in Written Language (Fixed Patterns)
footnotes_tr: In these types of patterns, you cannot exchange 之 with 的; the expressions are in a fixed (set) state.

tables.caption_tr: 百分之 (Percentage) and X分之Y (Fraction) Structures
rows: 三分之一 [sān fēn zhī yī]
四分之三 [sì fēn zhī sān]
数 + 倍 + 之 + 多
数倍之多 [shù bèi zhī duō]
footnotes_tr: After 百分之, 的 never follows; a number comes directly: 百分之十 (correct) / 百分之的十 (incorrect).
The order in fractions is fixed: first the denominator, then 分之, then the numerator.

tables.caption_tr: 之 + Directional/Locative/Temporal Words
rows: 两者之间 [liǎng zhě zhī jiān] 'ikisi arasında'
万人之上 [wàn rén zhī shàng] 'on binlerce insanın üstünde'
屋檐之下 [wūyán zhī xià] 'saçak altında'
无形之中 [wúxíng zhī zhōng] 'farkında olmadan'
三天之内 [sān tiān zhī nèi] 'üç gün içinde'
会议之前 [huìyì zhī qián] 'toplantıdan önce'
毕业之后 [bìyè zhī hòu] 'mezuniyetten sonra'
原因之一 [yuányīn zhī yī] 'nedenlerden biri'
新年之际 [xīnnián zhī jì] 'yeni yıl vesilesiyle'

tables.caption_tr: Fixed Conjunctions and Idioms Containing 之
rows: aksine, tersine (反之亦然 'tersi de doğrudur')
gibi şeyler, vesaire (书、笔之类的东西)

tables.caption_tr: Common Mistakes
rows: 之, 的 gibi serbestçe her isim tamlamasında kullanılamaz; yalnızca sabit kalıplarda geçerlidir.
百分之 sonrasında asla 的 gelmez, doğrudan sayı gelir.
Sıralama sabittir: 百分之 + sayı; ters çevrilmez.
'...-den biri' anlamı için 之一 kullanılır, 的一 değil.

tables.caption_tr: Advanced Awareness: Other Classical Uses of 之
footnotes_tr: These uses appear only in idioms; they are not productive in modern spoken language, it is enough to recognize them.

zhiyu.intro_tr: 至于[zhìyú] is an official conjunction used in a sentence to transition from a previously mentioned topic to a related but DIFFERENT and usually secondary subtopic; it corresponds to the Turkish expressions "when it comes to..." or "when it comes to the subject..." in Turkish. It is typically used in the pattern "A，至于B，...": first information about A is given, then with 至于 we transition to topic B and generally present more vague, incomplete or different information about B. 至于 is not used alone and out of context within a sentence — a topic must have been mentioned beforehand. At HSK5 level it appears more in written language and formal speech; it is used less in everyday conversation. It is important not to confuse 至于 with 对于 and 关于, because these do NOT CHANGE the topic, they only express information or attitude about a topic.

tables.caption_tr: Basic Sentence Structure of 至于
rows: A hakkında konuşulduktan sonra, B'ye (farklı ama ilişkili bir konuya) geçiş yapar
他很聪明，至于他弟弟，也不差。 [Tā hěn cōngming, zhìyú tā dìdi, yě bú chà.]
至于 + Soru İfadesi (什么/哪儿/怎么/几点...)
Henüz karara bağlanmamış, belirsiz bir detayı tanıtır
至于去不去，我还没想好。 [Zhìyú qù bu qù, wǒ hái méi xiǎnghǎo.]
Önceki bağlamdan sonra yeni bir alt konu başlatır
至于费用，公司会全部承担。 [Zhìyú fèiyòng, gōngsī huì quánbù chéngdān.]

tables.caption_tr: Comparison of 至于, 对于, 关于
rows: Önceki konudan farklı, yeni/ek bir alt konuya geçiş yapar
我今天很忙，至于明天，还不确定。 [Wǒ jīntiān hěn máng, zhìyú míngtiān, hái bú quèdìng.]
Genelde cümle ortasında, virgülden sonra kullanılır; bağlam gerektirir
Bir konu/olay hakkında tutum, duruş ya da ilişki bildirir
对于这个问题，我有不同的看法。 [Duìyú zhège wèntí, wǒ yǒu bùtóng de kànfǎ.]
Konuyu DEĞİŞTİRMEZ, sadece ona ilişkin görüş sunar
Bir konu hakkında bilgi/içerik sunar, başlıklarda sık kullanılır
关于这次会议，我们再谈谈。 [Guānyú zhè cì huìyì, wǒmen zài tántan.]
Genellikle cümle/makale BAŞINDA konuyu tanıtır, geçiş bildirmez

tables.caption_tr: Frequently Used Patterns with 至于
rows: 至于 + 疑问词 (什么/谁/哪儿/怎么/多少/几点)
至于怎么做，你自己决定吧。 [Zhìyú zěnme zuò, nǐ zìjǐ juédìng ba.]
至于没来的人，我们再联系。 [Zhìyú méi lái de rén, wǒmen zài liánxì.]
Resmî yazıda karşılaştırmalı iki durum sunar

tables.caption_tr: Common Mistakes
rows: Bağlamsız, cümlenin en başında tek başına 至于 ile konu başlatmak
至于, mutlaka önceki bir cümle/konu bağlamından SONRA kullanılır

关于 yeni konu tanıtır, 至于 konudan konuya GEÇİŞ yapar
关于这个电影，我们来聊聊。(doğru başlangıç) / 至于这个电影，我们来聊聊。(bağlam yoksa garip)
至于'den sonra gereksiz yere 的 kullanmak
至于 + konu adı doğrudan gelir, 的 gerekmez

fei-buke.intro_tr: The pattern 非...不可[fēi...bùkě] is a strong necessity expression that emphasizes that an action must definitely happen and that the opposite is unacceptable. The structure consists of two negative elements: 非[fēi] ("if not, is not") and 不可[bùkě] ("cannot, is not possible"); this double negation logically transforms into a strong affirmative, giving the meaning "definitely must ...". The basic pattern is 非[fēi] + [verb/clause] + 不可[bùkě] and expresses the speaker's determination, insistence, or the inevitability of a situation. In spoken language, 不可[bùkě] can be replaced with 不行[bùxíng] or 不成[bùchéng]; in fact, in very casual speech, the suffix can be dropped entirely and a similar meaning can be conveyed with just 非[fēi]. This structure carries a more emotional, emphatic, and sometimes insistent tone than neutral necessity expressions like 必须[bìxū].

zhi-suoyi.title_tr: 之所以...是因为... ('the reason that ... is...')
zhi-suoyi.intro_tr: The 之所以...是因为... structure is an advanced pattern used to explain the true reason for a result or situation in an emphasized and formal manner. In contrast to the 因为...所以... structure, here the RESULT (situation) is stated first, then the REASON; thus the listener's attention is drawn directly to the cause. The subject usually comes before 之所以: "Subject + 之所以 + result, + 是因为 + reason". This pattern is frequently preferred in written language, news texts, academic narratives, and conversations where it is particularly important to emphasize the reason. 之所以 is not used together with 所以; the conjunction that completes the sentence is always 是因为 (or its variations).

Özne + 之所以 + sonuç，是因为 + neden。

you-shoudao-zaodao.title_tr: Formal Passive Structures: 由[yóu], 受到[shòudào], 遭到[zāodào]
you-shoudao-zaodao.intro_tr: 由[yóu], 受到[shòudào], and 遭到[zāodào] are passive/agent-marking expressions preferred over 被[bèi] in formal written Chinese (news articles, reports, academic texts, formal speeches). 由[yóu] indicates who performs an action or who is responsible and is typically used with verbs like 负责[fùzé], 组成[zǔchéng], 决定[juédìng], 主持[zhǔchí]. 受到[shòudào] means 'to receive, to be subjected to' and can be used with both positive (受到欢迎 'to be welcomed') and negative (受到批评 'to be criticized') abstract nouns; it does not pair with bare verbs, typically matching with two-syllable abstract nouns. 遭到[zāodào] is used only for bad, unwanted situations (遭到反对 'to be opposed', 遭到破坏 'to be destroyed') and has a more negative/grave tone than 受到. These three patterns are rarely used in daily conversation; in colloquial speech, the simple 被[bèi] structure is typically preferred.

weibi.intro_tr: 未必[wèibì], meaning "definitely not, not necessarily," is a formal-toned adverb (副词[fùcí]). It is used to indicate that an event or judgment is not certain, not 100% guaranteed; it carries not a complete "no," but a meaning of "it may not be so." It comes after the subject and immediately before the verb or adjective predicate. In daily conversation, its closest equivalent is 不一定[bù yídìng], but 未必 carries a more literary and slightly more decisive "skepticism" tone. At the HSK5 level, you will frequently encounter it in discussions, expressing opinions, and formal written language.

tables.caption_tr: Basic Structure: Subject + 未必 + Predicate

Zhè wèibì shì zuì hǎo de bànfǎ.

Özne + 未必 + 会/能/想 + Fiil
O seni mutlaka anlayabilecek diye bir şey yok.
Öğrencilerin hepsi sınavı sevmek zorunda değil.
A: 他会赢吗? B: 未必。

examples.target: 他说的话未必是真的。
examples.reading: Tā shuō de huà wèibì shì zhēn de.
examples.translation_tr: What he said is not necessarily correct.

examples.target: 这件事未必像你想的那么简单。
examples.reading: Zhè jiàn shì wèibì xiàng nǐ xiǎng de nàme jiǎndān.
examples.translation_tr: This matter may not be as simple as you thought.

examples.target: 明天他未必会来。
examples.reading: Míngtiān tā wèibì huì lái.
examples.translation_tr: It is not certain that he will come tomorrow (he might not come either).

examples.target: 你说的未必不对,但我还是有别的看法。
examples.reading: Nǐ shuō de wèibì bú duì, dàn wǒ háishi yǒu bié de kànfǎ.
examples.translation_tr: What you said is not necessarily wrong, but I still have a different opinion.

examples.target: 便宜的东西未必质量差。
examples.reading: Piányi de dōngxi wèibì zhìliàng chà.
examples.translation_tr: Cheap things do not necessarily have poor quality.

examples.target: 这次考试未必比上次难。
examples.reading: Zhè cì kǎoshì wèibì bǐ shàng cì nán.
examples.translation_tr: This exam may not necessarily be harder than the previous exam.

examples.target: A:他一定会同意吧?B:未必。
examples.reading: A: Tā yídìng huì tóngyì ba? B: Wèibì.
examples.translation_tr: A: He will definitely accept, won't he? B: Not necessarily, it's uncertain.

er-contrast.title_tr: 而 (ér): A Conjunction Meaning 'and/but' in Written Language
er-contrast.intro_tr: 而 [ér] is a conjunction rarely used in everyday speech in modern Chinese, but is primarily specific to WRITTEN LANGUAGE (书面语). Its most striking feature is that depending on context, it can mean both "and, at the same time" (affirmative/parallel linking) and "but, yet" (contrast) — which meaning it takes is determined by whether the two elements it connects are compatible or opposite to each other. It generally links two monosyllabic or short adjectives, verb phrases, or clauses; it is not used to link nouns by itself (和 [hé] is used for that). 而 appears very frequently in formal writings, academic texts, idioms (成语), and classical quotations; for this reason it is important for reading and writing skills at HSK5 level. Moreover, it is also the fundamental building block of many fixed patterns like 为...而..., 因...而..., 从而, 反而, 而已.

tables.caption_tr: The four basic functions of 而
rows: 华而不实 [huá ér bù shí]
取而代之 [qǔ ér dài zhī]
为祖国而奋斗 [wèi zǔguó ér fèndòu]

tables.caption_tr: Fixed patterns formed with 而
rows: 为梦想而努力 [wèi mèngxiǎng ér nǔlì] — hayal için çabalamak
因病而缺席 [yīn bìng ér quēxí] — hastalık yüzünden katılamamak
他努力学习，从而取得了好成绩。[Tā nǔlì xuéxí, cóng'ér qǔdéle hǎo chéngjì.]
他不但不生气，反而笑了。[Tā búdàn bù shēngqì, fǎn'ér xiào le.]
我只是开玩笑而已。[Wǒ zhǐshì kāi wánxiào éryǐ.] — sadece şaka yapıyordum
这不是运气，而是努力的结果。[Zhè búshì yùnqi, érshì nǔlì de jiéguǒ.]
天气时而晴，时而雨。[Tiānqì shí'ér qíng, shí'ér yǔ.]
他先是一愣，继而大笑起来。[Tā xiānshi yí lèng, jì'ér dà xiào qǐlái.]

tables.caption_tr: What elements does 而 link? (Correct/incorrect usage)
rows: 大而无当 [dà ér wú dàng]
'büyük ama işe yaramaz' — sıfatları bağlamak 而'nin en tipik kullanımıdır
知而不言 [zhī ér bù yán]
'bilir ama söylemez' — kısa fiil öbeklerini bağlar
İsimleri bağlamak için 和 [hé] veya 与 [yǔ] kullanılmalıdır: 书和笔
Karşıtlık taşıyan iki cümleciği de bağlayabilir
为国家而牺牲 [wèi guójiā ér xīshēng]
为...而... veya 因...而... kalıbı şart

tables.caption_tr: Comparison of 而 with other conjunctions
rows: 美丽而聪明 [měilì ér cōngmíng] — güzel ve akıllı
我和你 [wǒ hé nǐ] — ben ve sen
便宜但是不好。[Piányi dànshì bù hǎo.]
他很累，却不休息。[Tā hěn lèi, què bù xiūxi.]
footnotes_tr: Since 而 can mean both 'and' and 'but' on its own, extracting meaning from context may be difficult for zero-level students; for this reason, it is recommended to first solidify the patterns 和 / 但是 / 而且 in spoken language, and then learn 而.

examples.target: 学而时习之，不亦说乎？
examples.reading: Xué ér shí xí zhī, bú yì yuè hū?
examples.translation_tr: Learning and reviewing it in time—isn't that delightful?
examples.note_tr: Here 而 is a classical 顺接 (sequential linking) usage linking two verb phrases (学 and 时习之). It is a famous saying by Confucius.

examples.target: 这个房间小而干净。
examples.reading: Zhège fángjiān xiǎo ér gānjìng.
examples.translation_tr: This room is small but clean.
examples.note_tr: The 而 linking two adjectives (小 and 干净) here carries a slight sense of contrast/balance: 'small but clean'.

examples.target: 他说而不做，让大家很失望。
examples.reading: Tā shuō ér bú zuò, ràng dàjiā hěn shīwàng.
examples.translation_tr: He speaks but does not act, which disappoints everyone.
examples.note_tr: Here 而 links two contrasting verb phrases (说 / 不做), giving a clear 转折 (but) meaning.

examples.target: 我们要为理想而奋斗。
examples.reading: Wǒmen yào wèi lǐxiǎng ér fèndòu.
examples.translation_tr: We must strive for our ideal.
examples.note_tr: The 为...而... pattern expresses purpose: '... for, for the sake of ...'. It appears very frequently in formal speech and writing.

examples.target: 这不是失败，而是新的开始。
examples.reading: Zhè búshì shībài, ér shì xīnde kāishǐ.
examples.translation_tr: This is not a failure, but rather a new beginning.
examples.note_tr: In the 不是...而是... pattern, 而是 means 'on the contrary, to the contrary'; it corrects a judgment.

examples.target: 华而不实的话不能相信。
examples.reading: Huá ér bù shí de huà bùnéng xiāngxìn.
examples.translation_tr: Flowery but hollow words cannot be trusted.
examples.note_tr: 华而不实 is a four-character fixed idiom (成语); here 而 links the qualities 'flowery' (华) and 'not genuine' (不实) by creating a contrast.

examples.target: 由此而知，他早已知道真相。
examples.reading: Yóu cǐ ér zhī, tā zǎoyǐ zhīdào zhēnxiàng.
examples.translation_tr: From this it can be understood that he had long since known the truth.
examples.note_tr: 由此而知 is a fixed pattern frequently used in formal written language: 'from this it can be understood'.

jingguo-tongguo.title_tr: 经过 / 通过 ('... by means of, through')
jingguo-tongguo.intro_tr: 经过[jīngguò] and 通过[tōngguò] are both two words frequently encountered at HSK level 5 that can be translated into Turkish as '...by means of, ...through, ...thanks to'; however, what they emphasize is different. 经过[jīngguò] emphasizes passing through a PLACE (physically) or passing through a PROCESS/TIME and reaching a result — that is, 'by experiencing something, after a process'. 通过[tōngguò], on the other hand, emphasizes reaching a result by using a TOOL, METHOD, or MEANS — that is, 'thanks to something, by using a way/tool'. Additionally, 通过[tōngguò] alone is also used as an independent verb meaning 'to pass, to be accepted' (exam, proposal, etc.); this usage does not apply to 经过[jīngguò]. Both words are typically used at the beginning of a sentence in the pattern "经过/通过 + X，Y" and X explains how result Y was achieved.

tables.caption_tr: General Comparison of 经过[jīngguò] and 通过[tōngguò]
rows: evet: 经过学校 (okulun önünden geçmek)
Soyut bir süreç sonrası sonuç (uzun çaba, tartışma, tedavi vb.)
sınırlı, genelde 努力/学习 gibi durumlarda ikisi de olabilir
Bir aracı/kişi/yöntem üzerinden bir şey yapmak
evet, en yaygın kullanım: 通过朋友, 通过网络
经过三年的努力 (üç yıllık çabadan sonra)

tables.caption_tr: 经过[jīngguò] Usage Patterns
rows: 经过[jīngguò]公园[gōngyuán]，我们[wǒmen]看到了[kàndào le]很多人[hěnduōrén]。
uzun bir süreç/zamandan sonra Y sonucuna ulaşılır
经过 + soyut süreç (讨论, 研究, 调查 vb.)
经过[jīngguò]讨论[tǎolùn]，大家[dàjiā]同意[tóngyì]了[le]这个[zhège]计划[jìhuà]。

tables.caption_tr: 通过[tōngguò] Usage Patterns
rows: 通过 + kişi/kurum (阿姨, 老师, 公司 vb.)
通过[tōngguò]老师[lǎoshī]的[de]帮助[bāngzhù]，他[tā]提高[tígāo]了[le]成绩[chéngjì]。
bağımsız fiil: geçmek, kabul edilmek, onaylanmak
是...的 yapısıyla birlikte yöntemi vurgulamak
这个[zhège]问题[wèntí]是[shì]通过[tōngguò]讨论[tǎolùn]解决[jiějué]的[de]。

tables.caption_tr: Situations Where 经过 and 通过 Can Sometimes Be Used Interchangeably
rows: 经过/通过 + 努力，他成功了。
经过: 'çabayı yaşayarak, bu süreçten geçerek' / 通过: 'çaba sayesinde, çabayı bir araç olarak kullanarak' — anlam çok yakın, ikisi de doğru
经过/通过 + 学习，水平提高了。
İkisi de kabul edilir, ama 通过 'öğrenmeyi bir yöntem olarak kullanmayı' daha çok vurgular

tables.caption_tr: Common Mistakes
rows: 经过电话，我告诉了他这件事。 (yanlış)
通过[tōngguò]电话[diànhuà]，我[wǒ]告诉[gàosu]了[le]他[tā]这件事[zhèjiànshì]。
电话 (telefon) bir araç/vasıtadır, bir yer veya süreç değildir; bu yüzden 通过 kullanılmalı, 经过 değil.
'Sınavı geçmek' anlamında bağımsız fiil olarak sadece 通过 kullanılır, 经过 bu anlamı taşımaz.
通过公园，我们看见了很多花。 (yanlış/garip)
经过[jīngguò]公园[gōngyuán]，我们[wǒmen]看见[kànjiàn]了[le]很多[hěnduō]花[huā]。
Somut/fiziksel bir yerden geçmek için 经过 tercih edilir; 通过 burada doğal değildir.

examples.target: 我们经过公园的时候，看见了很多花。
examples.reading: Wǒmen jīngguò gōngyuán de shíhou, kànjiànle hěn duō huā.
examples.translation_tr: While passing through the park, we saw a lot of flowers.
examples.note_tr: 经过 is used here in the sense of physically passing through a concrete place.

examples.target: 经过这次旅行，我了解了很多中国文化。
examples.reading: Jīngguò zhè cì lǚxíng, wǒ liǎojiěle hěn duō Zhōngguó wénhuà.
examples.translation_tr: After experiencing this trip (during this trip process), I learned a lot about Chinese culture.
examples.note_tr: 经过 is used here in the sense of an abstract experience/process.

examples.target: 经过三年的努力，他终于实现了自己的梦想。
examples.reading: Jīngguò sān nián de nǔlì, tā zhōngyú shíxiànle zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng.
examples.translation_tr: After three years of effort, he/she finally realized his/her own dream.
examples.note_tr: It is a very common pattern that expresses reaching a result after a long process.

examples.target: 通过学习汉语，我交了很多中国朋友。
examples.reading: Tōngguò xuéxí Hànyǔ, wǒ jiāole hěn duō Zhōngguó péngyou.
examples.translation_tr: By/thanks to learning Chinese, I made many Chinese friends.
examples.note_tr: 通过 is used here in the sense of a method/tool, 学习汉语 is thought of as a 'tool'.

examples.target: 他通过了这次考试。
examples.reading: Tā tōngguòle zhè cì kǎoshì.
examples.translation_tr: He/she passed this exam.
examples.note_tr: 通过 is used here as an independent verb in the sense of 'to pass, to be accepted'; 经过 cannot be used in this sense.

examples.target: 我是通过朋友介绍认识她的。
examples.reading: Wǒ shì tōngguò péngyou jièshào rènshi tā de.
examples.translation_tr: I got to know him/her through (by means of) an introduction by a friend of mine.
examples.note_tr: Used together with the 是...的 structure to emphasize the method/tool.

examples.target: 这个消息通过电视传遍了全国。
examples.reading: Zhège xiāoxi tōngguò diànshì chuánbiànle quánguó.
examples.translation_tr: This news spread throughout the entire country through television.
examples.note_tr: 通过 + a concrete tool (电视) pattern.

examples.target: 经过医生的治疗，他的病好多了。
examples.reading: Jīngguò yīshēng de zhìliáo, tā de bìng hǎo duōle.
examples.translation_tr: After the doctor's treatment process, the illness improved greatly.
examples.note_tr: 经过 is used here in the sense of a process/treatment, within a structure emphasizing the result.

nanguai-guaibude.title_tr: 难怪 / 怪不得 ('that explains it' / 'no wonder')
nanguai-guaibude.intro_tr: 难怪[nánguài] and 怪不得[guàibude] correspond to Turkish expressions such as "that explains it" (demek o yüzdenmiş), "no wonder" (hiç şaşmamalı ki), and "so that's why" (meğer bu yüzdenmiş). A speaker first notices a situation they find strange or surprising; then, when they learn the real reason, they use these expressions to say "now I understand why, because that's the cause." These two expressions have nearly identical meanings and can be used interchangeably in most contexts; the only difference is that 难怪 is preferred in both written and spoken language, while 怪不得 is more commonly used in everyday conversation. The sentence is generally constructed with 原来[yuánlái] ("it turns out" / "as it happens"), because 原来 introduces the real cause, while 难怪/怪不得 expresses the "so that's why" reaction to it. Additionally, 怪不得 can be broken down as "怪[guài] + 不得[bude]" and used differently to mean "cannot be blamed, cannot be faulted"; this should not be confused with the adverbial usage meaning "no wonder."

tables.caption_tr: 难怪[nánguài] and 怪不得[guàibude] Comparison
rows: 难怪他没来，原来他生病了。
怪不得他没来，原来他生病了。

tables.caption_tr: Basic Sentence Structures
rows: 难怪/怪不得 + Sonuç Cümlesi，原来 + Sebep Cümlesi
Önce şaşırtıcı durum söylenir, sonra 原来 ile gerçek sebep açıklanır
难怪你没吃饭，原来你已经吃过了。
原来 + Sebep Cümlesi，难怪/怪不得 + Sonuç Cümlesi
Sebep önce söylenir, sonra 难怪/怪不得 ile 'demek o yüzdenmiş' tepkisi verilir
原来你感冒了，难怪你脸色这么差。
难怪/怪不得 + Sonuç Cümlesi (原来 olmadan)
Sebep bağlamdan zaten biliniyorsa 原来 atlanabilir
A：他辞职了。 B：难怪他今天没来。
难怪 özneden sonra da gelebilir, vurgu özneye kayar
他难怪这么高兴，是因为他中奖了。

tables.caption_tr: Frequently Used Expressions with 难怪 / 怪不得
rows: Genellikle bu iki ifadeyle birlikte kullanılır, gerçek sebebi tanıtır
原来 + isim tamlaması olduğunda 是 eklenir
难怪 bu anlamda KULLANILMAZ, sadece 怪不得/不怪 bu ikinci anlamı taşır

tables.caption_tr: Common Mistakes
rows: 难怪他没来，原来他生病了。
难怪 tek başına yeterli değildir; sonuç cümlesiyle birlikte, genellikle 原来 ile sebep cümlesine bağlanmalıdır
难怪因为下雨，地上很湿。
难怪地上这么湿，原来下雨了。
难怪/怪不得 zaten sebep-sonuç ilişkisini kurar; 因为 ile birlikte tekrar kullanmaya gerek yoktur
这不怪你。 / 这怪不得你。
'Kabahat bulunamaz' anlamında sadece 怪/怪不得 kullanılır, 难怪 bu anlamda kullanılmaz
怪不得原来他很累。 (sıra yanlış)
怪不得他很累，原来他工作到很晚。
原来 sebep cümlesinin başına, 难怪/怪不得 ise sonuç (şaşırtıcı durum) cümlesinin başına gelir

examples.target: 难怪你今天这么高兴，原来你考试考得很好。
examples.reading: Nánguài nǐ jīntiān zhème gāoxìng, yuánlái nǐ kǎoshì kǎo de hěn hǎo.
examples.translation_tr: That's why you're so happy today; you must have done very well on the exam.

examples.target: 怪不得他不在教室，原来他生病了。
examples.reading: Guàibude tā bú zài jiàoshì, yuánlái tā shēngbìng le.
examples.translation_tr: That's why she wasn't in class; she must have been sick.

examples.target: 外面一直在下雨，难怪地上这么湿。
examples.reading: Wàimiàn yìzhí zài xià yǔ, nánguài dìshang zhème shī.
examples.translation_tr: It must have been raining outside all the time; that's why the ground is so wet.

examples.target: 怪不得这么冷，原来昨天晚上下雪了。
examples.reading: Guàibude zhème lěng, yuánlái zuótiān wǎnshang xià xuě le.
examples.translation_tr: That's why it's so cold; it must have snowed last night.

examples.target: 难怪她汉语说得这么好，原来她在中国住过五年。
examples.reading: Nánguài tā Hànyǔ shuō de zhème hǎo, yuánlái tā zài Zhōngguó zhùguo wǔ nián.
examples.translation_tr: That's why she speaks Chinese so well; she must have lived in China for five years.

examples.target: 原来你已经吃过饭了，怪不得你不饿。
examples.reading: Yuánlái nǐ yǐjīng chīguo fàn le, guàibude nǐ bú è.
examples.translation_tr: I see you've already eaten; that's why you're not hungry.

examples.target: A：他昨天辞职了。 B：难怪他今天没来上班。
examples.reading: A: Tā zuótiān cízhí le. B: Nánguài tā jīntiān méi lái shàngbān.
examples.translation_tr: A: He/she resigned from work yesterday. B: That's why he/she didn't come to work today.

examples.target: 这件事不怪你，你已经尽力了。
examples.reading: Zhè jiàn shì bú guài nǐ, nǐ yǐjīng jìnlì le.
examples.translation_tr: This is not your fault; you already did all you could. (Note: the 不怪 here is a different pattern and should not be confused with 难怪)

jianzhi.intro_tr: 简直[jiǎnzhí] is a strong adverb used in Chinese to express emotional exaggeration and surprise; it corresponds to the Turkish expressions "formally," "literally," "just like," or "absolutely." It is typically used together with structures like 太...了, 是, 就是 to emphasize how extreme, unbelievable, or surprising the speaker finds a situation. It expresses a subjective impression or feeling rather than an objective fact, which is why it frequently appears in spoken language and everyday narratives. It should not be confused with 几乎[jīhū] (almost/nearly); while 简直 contains exaggeration and emotion, 几乎 only indicates proximity in quantity or number.

tables.caption_tr: Basic Structures of 简直[jiǎnzhí]
rows: 简直 + 太 + Sıfat + 了
Aşırı duygusal vurgu, en sık kullanılan kalıp
简直太好了[jiǎnzhí tài hǎo le] (resmen çok iyi)
简直是天才[jiǎnzhí shì tiāncái] (resmen dâhi)
简直 + 就是 + İsim/İsim Öbeği
简直就是奇迹[jiǎnzhí jiùshì qíjì] (tam anlamıyla mucize)
简直要疯了[jiǎnzhí yào fēng le] (neredeyse çıldıracağım)
简直不敢相信[jiǎnzhí bùgǎn xiāngxìn] (adeta inanamıyorum)
简直像做梦一样[jiǎnzhí xiàng zuòmèng yíyàng] (adeta rüya gibi)
footnotes_tr: 简直 almost always appears in the sentence after the subject and before the verb/adjective.
简直 is not used alone with a bare adjective; it typically comes together with emphatic elements like 太...了, 是, 就是.

tables.caption_tr: Comparison of 简直[jiǎnzhí] with Similar Adverbs
rows: Öznel duygu ve abartı içerir; gerçek dışı gibi görünen bir durumu vurgular
Nesnel miktar/oran yakınlığını belirtir, duygusal abartı taşımaz
Tam kapsamı ifade eder, şaşkınlık/duygu vurgusu yoktur
Belirsizlik ve tahmin bildirir, kesinlik iddiası taşımaz
简直 + 是 birleşimi; nitelendirmeyi kesinleştirir, karşılaştırmalı güçlü ifade

tables.caption_tr: Frequently Used 简直 Patterns
footnotes_tr: These patterns are especially used in everyday spoken language when expressing surprise, admiration, or annoyance.

tables.caption_tr: Common Mistakes
rows: 简直 yalın bir sıfatla tek başına kullanılmaz; genellikle 太...了 veya 极了 gibi vurgu yapılarıyla birlikte gelir
简直好极了！ / 简直太好了！
简直 ile 很 doğal bir kombinasyon oluşturmaz; 极了 veya 太...了 tercih edilmelidir
简直 ve 几乎 aynı cümlede yan yana kullanılarak anlam tekrarına (redundancy) yol açılmamalıdır
简直 abartı/şaşkınlık taşımayan sıradan cümlelerde kullanılmaz; duygusal vurgu gerektirir

examples.target: 这个消息简直太好了！
examples.reading: Zhège xiāoxi jiǎnzhí tài hǎo le!
examples.translation_tr: This news is simply so good!
examples.note_tr: The 简直 + 太...了 pattern emphasizes emotional surprise.

examples.target: 他说的话简直是胡说八道。
examples.reading: Tā shuō de huà jiǎnzhí shì húshuō bādào.
examples.translation_tr: What he/she said is simply nonsense.
examples.note_tr: With the 简直是 + noun pattern, a definite/strong characterization is made.

examples.target: 这里的风景简直就是天堂。
examples.reading: Zhèlǐ de fēngjǐng jiǎnzhí jiù shì tiāntáng.
examples.translation_tr: The scenery here is literally like paradise.
examples.note_tr: 简直就是 is a stronger/more emphatic form of the 简直是 structure.

examples.target: 我简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。
examples.reading: Wǒ jiǎnzhí bùgǎn xiāngxìn zìjǐ de yǎnjīng.
examples.translation_tr: I literally couldn't believe my eyes.
examples.note_tr: 简直不敢相信 is a fixed pattern used in situations of great surprise.

examples.target: 这道题简直太难了，我一点儿也不会做。
examples.reading: Zhè dào tí jiǎnzhí tài nán le, wǒ yìdiǎnr yě bú huì zuò.
examples.translation_tr: This question is simply so difficult, I can't do it at all.

examples.target: 他的中文说得简直和中国人一样。
examples.reading: Tā de Zhōngwén shuō de jiǎnzhí hé Zhōngguórén yíyàng.
examples.translation_tr: His/her Chinese is literally like that of a native Chinese speaker.
examples.note_tr: 简直 is used here together with the 和...一样 (comparison) structure.

examples.target: 这场比赛简直太精彩了！
examples.reading: Zhè chǎng bǐsài jiǎnzhí tài jīngcǎi le!
examples.translation_tr: This match was simply amazing!

examples.target: 浪费这么多时间，简直是犯罪！
examples.reading: Làngfèi zhème duō shíjiān, jiǎnzhí shì fànzuì!
examples.translation_tr: Wasting so much time is simply a crime!
examples.note_tr: An example of exaggerated/figurative use.

written-vs-spoken.title_tr: Written Language vs Spoken Language (书面语 / 口语)
written-vs-spoken.intro_tr: In Chinese, two different "registers" are typically used to express the same meaning: 口语[kǒuyǔ] (spoken language) in everyday conversation, messaging, and intimate communication; 书面语[shūmiànyǔ] (written language) in news, formal correspondence, academic texts, and literary works. The difference between them is not only in word choice, but also in sentence length, use of conjunctions, particles, and pronouns. Spoken language is short, filled with filler words, and enriched with particles like 啊/呢/吧, while written language typically uses monosyllabic formal words, complex conjunctions, and is precise. From HSK5 level onwards, it is necessary to recognize 书面语 vocabulary in reading texts and formal correspondence; using these words in everyday conversation may come across as artificial and strange. This page summarizes the fundamental differences between the two registers, equivalent word pairs, and in table form which register is preferred in which context.

ningke-yebu.title_tr: 宁可[nìngkě]...也不[yě bù]... — "...I'd rather..., than..."
ningke-yebu.intro_tr: The pattern "宁可[nìngkě]...也不[yě bù]..." is used when making a strong and firm preference between two options: the speaker accepts option A, no matter how difficult, unpleasant, or requiring sacrifice, but will absolutely not do option B. This corresponds to Turkish expressions like "...I prefer to..., not to..." or "...I'd do this rather than do that". 宁可 (sometimes 宁愿[nìngyuàn] or 宁肯[nìngkěn]) indicates the difficult action that is preferred, while 也不 indicates the action that will never be done. If the second clause expresses reaching a difficult goal rather than avoiding a negative action, then 也要[yě yào] is used instead of 也不. This structure generally carries an air of stubborn, emotional, or principled determination.

tables.caption_tr: The basic components of the structure
rows: 宁可 / 宁愿 / 宁肯
"Tercih ederim ki..." — kabul edilen, genelde zor/fedakarlık gerektiren seçenek
Birinci cümlenin başında, öznenin önünde veya sonrasında
"...bile olsa yapacağım" — olumsuz değil, zor bir hedefe ulaşma vurgusu
footnotes_tr: The action in the first clause is generally a difficult, uncomfortable, or costly option; this emphasizes how strong the preference is.

宁愿[nìngyuàn]单身也不将就[jiāngjiù] — Bekar kalmayı tercih ederim, gönülsüzce razı olmam
Biraz daha resmi, yazı diline yakın

examples.target: 我宁可走路，也不坐他的车。
examples.reading: Wǒ nìngkě zǒulù, yě bú zuò tā de chē.
examples.translation_tr: I prefer walking, rather than taking his car.

examples.target: 他宁可饿着肚子，也不吃这种药。
examples.reading: Tā nìngkě èzhe dùzi, yě bù chī zhè zhǒng yào.
examples.translation_tr: He prefers staying hungry, but won't take this medicine.

examples.target: 我们宁可多花点钱，也要买质量好的产品。

examples.translation_tr: We're willing to spend a bit more money in order to get quality products.
examples.note_tr: Here, 也要 is used instead of 也不: it emphasizes reaching a difficult goal, not avoiding something negative.

examples.target: 她宁愿一个人过，也不愿意将就。
examples.reading: Tā nìngyuàn yí gè rén guò, yě bú yuànyì jiāngjiù.
examples.translation_tr: He prefers living alone, rather than reluctantly settling.

examples.target: 宁可站着死，也不跪着生。
examples.reading: Nìngkě zhànzhe sǐ, yě bú guìzhe shēng.
examples.translation_tr: I prefer dying on my feet, rather than living on my knees.

examples.target: 他宁肯自己受苦，也不愿意麻烦别人。
examples.reading: Tā nìngkěn zìjǐ shòukǔ, yě bú yuànyì máfan biérén.
examples.translation_tr: He prefers to suffer rather than trouble others.

examples.target: 我宁可失败，也不放弃梦想。
examples.reading: Wǒ nìngkě shībài, yě bú fàngqì mèngxiǎng.
examples.translation_tr: I'm willing to accept failure, but I will never give up on my dream.

shifou.title_tr: 是否 (shìfǒu): Official '... Whether or Not' Structure
shifou.intro_tr: The word 是否[shìfǒu] means exactly '是不是' (yes or no), but is a much more formal and written-language-specific structure. It is composed of the combination of the syllables 是[shì] 'yes/is' and 否[fǒu] 'no/not', and by itself corresponds to the pattern 'whether or not'. It is generally used in formal correspondence, news articles, reports, and embedded questions; in everyday spoken language, 是不是[shìbushì] or the V不V structure is preferred instead. 是否 is not used to form a direct question sentence, but mostly to express '...whether or not' as an object clause within a sentence. It is placed immediately before the verb or adjective and does not take a negative suffix (是否不 is incorrect); moreover, it is not used together with question particles like 吗.

tables.caption_tr: 是否 (shìfǒu) Basic Structure and Position
rows: 无论 + Özne + 是否 + Yüklem
sen kabul etsen de etmesen de
footnotes_tr: 是否 comes directly before the verb/adjective, with no other elements in between.
是否 + 不 cannot be used; negation is already inherent in the syllable 否.
吗 is not added to the end of the sentence, because 是否 already contains a 'yes-no' question.

tables.caption_tr: 是否 vs 是不是 vs 有没有 vs V不V: Comparison
rows: Raporlar, haberler, dolaylı sorular, embedded clauses
footnotes_tr: 是否 is the formal/written equivalent of 是不是; the two are semantically equivalent but formally different.
Using 是否 in spoken language can sound overly formal/artificial; 是不是 is preferred in everyday dialogue.
是否 is generally found in a subordinate clause that is the object of a main clause (indirect question); V不V and 是不是, on the other hand, are more common in independent direct questions.

tables.caption_tr: Verbs and Patterns Frequently Used with 是否

请确认是否属实。(Qǐng quèrèn shìfǒu shǔshí.)
大家讨论是否值得投资。(Dàjiā tǎolùn shìfǒu zhíde tóuzī.)
公司决定是否录用他。(Gōngsī juédìng shìfǒu lùyòng tā.)
我不知道是否来得及。(Wǒ bù zhīdào shìfǒu láidejí.)
请说明是否同意此方案。(Qǐng shuōmíng shìfǒu tóngyì cǐ fāng'àn.)
结果取决于是否努力。(Jiéguǒ qǔjuéyú shìfǒu nǔlì.)
footnotes_tr: These verbs are typically cognitive/administrative actions like 'think, ask, discuss, decide'; 是否 initiates the subordinate clause that is their object.

你是否会去? / 你去不去?
nǐ shìfǒu huì qù? / nǐ qù bu qù?

Günlük sohbette aşırı resmî ve yapmacık durur

rìcháng kǒuyǔ yòng shìbushì / V bu V

examples.target: 我想知道他是否愿意帮忙。
examples.reading: Wǒ xiǎng zhīdào tā shìfǒu yuànyì bāngmáng.
examples.translation_tr: I want to know whether he is willing to help or not.
examples.note_tr: 是否 is used here within an indirect question clause, instead of 是不是 - more formal.

examples.target: 请确认您是否已经收到邮件。
examples.reading: Qǐng quèrèn nín shìfǒu yǐjīng shōudào yóujiàn.
examples.translation_tr: Please confirm whether you received the email or not.
examples.note_tr: A very common pattern in formal correspondence: 请确认是否...

examples.target: 老师询问学生是否理解了这个语法。
examples.reading: Lǎoshī xúnwèn xuéshēng shìfǒu lǐjiěle zhège yǔfǎ.
examples.translation_tr: The teacher asked the students whether they understood this grammar or not.
examples.note_tr: 询问 (ask, formal) + 是否 is used together very frequently.

examples.target: 无论你是否同意,决定已经做出了。
examples.reading: Wúlùn nǐ shìfǒu tóngyì, juédìng yǐjīng zuòchūle.
examples.translation_tr: Whether you agree or not, the decision has already been made.
examples.note_tr: The 无论...是否... structure conveys the meaning 'whether or not'.

examples.target: 我们需要讨论一下这个计划是否可行。
examples.reading: Wǒmen xūyào tǎolùn yíxià zhège jìhuà shìfǒu kěxíng.
examples.translation_tr: We need to discuss whether this plan is feasible or not.
examples.note_tr: 是否可行 is a very frequently encountered formal pattern.

examples.target: 他没有说明是否会来参加会议。
examples.reading: Tā méiyǒu shuōmíng shìfǒu huì lái cānjiā huìyì.
examples.translation_tr: He did not clarify whether he will attend the meeting or not.
examples.note_tr: 说明 (clarify) + 是否 is used in indirect narration.

examples.target: 是否成功取决于你的努力。
examples.reading: Shìfǒu chénggōng qǔjuéyú nǐ de nǔlì.
examples.translation_tr: Whether you will succeed or not depends on your effort.
examples.note_tr: 是否 can also be used in subject position at the beginning of a sentence.

examples.target: 请告诉我你是否需要帮助。
examples.reading: Qǐng gàosu wǒ nǐ shìfǒu xūyào bāngzhù.
examples.translation_tr: Please tell me whether you need help from me or not.
examples.note_tr: In everyday conversation, this sentence is generally said as 你要不要帮助; 是否 is a written/formal preference.

hekuang.intro_tr: 何况[hékuàng] is a rhetorical conjunction and corresponds to Turkish expressions such as "let alone, besides, and so on". The speaker first mentions an easier or less important situation, then uses 何况[hékuàng] to emphasize a more difficult/important situation, establishing the logic of "if even the simple case is this way, don't even think about the difficult one". It is usually used together with the structure 连...都/也[lián...dōu/yě] ("even") and the sentence usually ends as a rhetorical question ending with 呢[ne]. 更何况[gèng hékuàng], on the other hand, is a variant that emphasizes the same meaning more powerfully and is used very frequently in both spoken and written language, and usually adds an additional reason/situation to the previous sentence. This structure is an advanced conjunction at HSK5 level and frequently appears in sentences involving discussion, persuasion, and logical reasoning.

yaome-yaome.intro_tr: The 要么[yàome]...要么[yàome]... pattern is used to express that one of two (or more) mutually exclusive options must be chosen; it is an exact equivalent of the "ya... ya..." structure in Turkish. It emphasizes that both options cannot occur at the same time, and only one can be valid. Usually, the speaker makes a suggestion or indicates that one of two situations is mandatory. The subject can be the same person in both subordinate clauses or different people. It should not be confused with 或者[huòzhě] and 还是[háishi]; this pattern more strongly expresses the obligation of a definite choice and is not used in interrogative sentences.
